Closed-internet trials run on Modal via harbor + harbor_ext (ManagedModalEnvironment + claude-code-api-key-no-search / codex-api-key-no-search wrappers). Each sandbox had only its agent's LLM-provider IP allowlisted (Anthropic for claude-code, OpenAI for codex). Every trial in this manifest was independently validated to (a) have no exception_info, (b) carry the per-trial network-resolution.json proving the CIDR allowlist held, (c) show no infra-failure markers (invalid_api_key, SIGTERM, credential-not-loaded) in its agent log. Embedding-eval is deliberately excluded — task owner has flagged it as not yet ready. Gemini-cli is deferred until a working GEMINI_API_KEY is provisioned.
